entries.decision: A deterministic informational mapping is justified only when the AnalogRadioService V2.4 candidate/integration profile is explicitly selected, the candidate XSD result is VALID, and RadioTelegramStructure omits Transmitter.
guards: must not run for an official V2.4 strict profile because no official release-XSD authority exists
must not change the candidate XSD VALID result
must not claim official V2.4 conformance
must not require Transmitter despite the PDF table's 1:1 row
evidence: EV-105 confirms candidate XSD accepts SendTelegram with and without Transmitter
official V2.4 PDF is internally contradictory: table 1:1 vs embedded schema minOccurs=0

entries.decision: An exact operation-path warning is justified when AnalogRadioService V2.4 context contains the literal SendFFSKTelegram path segment from the erroneous URI example.
guards: exact literal match only; no fuzzy operation-name matching
must recommend SendTelegram but never rewrite the observed URI
must not register SendFFSKTelegram as an operation alias
must not imply an official V2.4 XSD profile exists
evidence: official V2.4 operation inventory and XML example use SendTelegram
only the concrete URI example uses SendFFSKTelegram
